sources.workflowType: Aliquot Ensemble Somatic Variant Merging and Masking

sources.title: UniProtKB reviewed human PIK3CA entry P42336

transformations.mutationSelection: Retain PIK3CA rows on ENST00000263967 whose GDC Variant_Classification is in proteinAlteringClasses.
transformations.proteinCoordinate: Use the first affected residue encoded by HGVSp_Short; fall back to the first Protein_position residue. Output is one-based on P42336 sequence version 2; preserve Protein_position as sourceProteinPosition.
transformations.aggregation: Truncate Tumor_Sample_Barcode to the 16-character TCGA sample barcode and count distinct samples for each position, HGVSp_Short change, and variant class.
transformations.displayThreshold: Retain aggregated events observed in at least two distinct tumour samples.
transformations.domains: Select the five named Domain features from P42336 and preserve their one-based closed locations.

mutations.coordinateSystem: one-based amino-acid position on UniProt P42336 sequence version 2

domains.coordinateSystem: one-based closed amino-acid intervals on UniProt P42336 sequence version 2

deployedConsumerComparison.note: The maintained spec was inspected but not changed; the recipe-local spec uses relative output URLs instead of embedded processed rows.
